# awscc_lightsail_key_pair (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Lightsail::KeyPair



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_pair_name` (String) The name of the key pair.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tag keys and optional values to add to the resource during create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the key pair was created.
- `fingerprint` (String) The RSA fingerprint of the key pair.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `key_pair_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key pair.
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `resource_type` (String) The Lightsail resource type (KeyPair).
- `support_code` (String) The support code. Include this code in your email to support when you have questions about a key pair in Lightsail.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String) The Availability Zone. Follows the format us-east-2a (case-sensitive).
- `region_name` (String) The AWS Region name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lightsail_key_pair.example
  identity = {
    key_pair_name = "key_pair_name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `key_pair_name` (String) The name of the key pair

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lightsail_key_pair.example
  id = "key_pair_name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_lightsail_key_pair.example "key_pair_name"
```
